core: Identify the trust boundary, select one domain reference, then answer from that reference only.

mobile.browser-flow: Authorization Code with PKCE through the system browser.
mobile.rotation: Use refresh-token rotation and device-bound revocation where supported.
mobile.session-storage: Store refresh material in the platform secure enclave or keychain.

oauth.rotation: Rotate refresh tokens after use and revoke the previous token.
oauth.session-storage: Server-side session ID in an HttpOnly, Secure cookie.

service-account.browser-flow: No browser flow; use workload identity or a short-lived client assertion.
service-account.rotation: Prefer short-lived identity; otherwise rotate credentials with overlap.
service-account.session-storage: No user session; keep credentials in a managed secret store.

webhook.browser-flow: No browser flow; use a signed server-to-server delivery.
webhook.rotation: Accept active and next signing secrets during a bounded rotation window.
webhook.session-storage: Do not create a browser session; verify the signed request body.
